resources.string: Lets Arrow AutoBot tap and pinch inside Arrow Puzzle. It never reads your keystrokes, passwords or personal data.
Shows whether the bot is playing and lets you stop it.

1. Enable the accessibility service.
2. Open Arrow Puzzle and leave it on a level.
3. Tap Start bot and accept screen capture.

The bot plays only while Arrow Puzzle is in the foreground. Every tap is checked against the live board first; if anything is unclear it slows down to one tap per screenshot instead of guessing. Keep the notification running while you play.
Nothing is tapped until a stable board is detected.
Android needs the Arrow AutoBot accessibility service to send taps. It only performs gestures; it does not read passwords or personal data.
Allow notifications so the bot can show its Stop button.
